articles.title: Samson Mow says bitcoin bottom is in despite skepticism from analysts
articles.snippet: The bitcoin advocate said his crypto bottom claim is based on the fact that the traditional four-year halving cycle has changed, although several analysts continue to expect further downside.

articles.title: Michael Saylor teases more bitcoin buying even as Strategy stock continues to fall
articles.snippet: The crypto bull shrugged off market skepticism by sharing a chart of the company's $50 billion stash and teasing that they are going to need more data points.

articles.title: SBI's $289 million Bitbank deal is symptomatic of Japan's crypto consolidation: Architect Partners
articles.snippet: The investment bank said the purchase of Japanese crypto exchange Bitbank is a bet on regulated scale as sweeping reforms reshape the country's digital asset market.

articles.title: Crypto's next frontier isn't crypto, it's financing AI and robotics, Framework's Anderson says
articles.snippet: Blockchain is becoming the financial layer for capital-intensive industries rather than just crypto-native speculation, Michael Anderson, the crypto venture firm's cofounder, said.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000, on track for a rare back-to-back quarterly loss
articles.snippet: The token is down nearly 7% on the week with the altcoins falling harder. Bitcoin and ether are both ending the second quarter in the red, a back-to-back losing first half that runs against the usual pattern.
